thread.title: Jim Cramer's on Why Google Just Can't Make Analysts Happy

author: Katherine Ross
title: Jim Cramer's on Why Google Just Can't Make Analysts Happy
text:
Jim Cramer thinks that it may be time for analysts to try some CBD.
The founder of TheStreet expressed his thoughts on why he feels that companies such as Alphabet ( GOOGL ) and Apple ( AAPL ) are "unable to please anyone."
"Last night on what I regarded as a fairly nasty conference call, multiple analysts called out Alphabet for spending with no real tomorrow in sight. I thought that was a harsh call, but when you think how little its Other Bets have made for the company, it's a legitimate concern. I sure wish there was a more linear cost and effect. There does, at times, feel like there is no amount of money they won't spend in pursuit of who knows what! After all, the only noteworthy Other Bet that has come in lately is Nest -- and I would rather have Honeywell ( HON ) spinoff, Resideo, than Nest," Cramer wrote in his Real Money column.
Cramer explains himself in TheStreet's live show .
Alphabet, Apple and Honeywell are holdings in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS member club
